episodes.name: Baymax Returns
episodes.overviewEn: Hiro thinks Baymax is lost forever, until he finds the chip that Tadashi designed to create Baymax. Hiro immediately gets to work rebuilding his friend.

episodes.name: Issue 188
episodes.overviewEn: As Hiro tries to find a way to connect to classmate Karmi, Go Go and Fred dive deep into comic book mythology to defeat High Voltage, a mother-daughter supervillain duo.

episodes.name: Big Roommates 2
episodes.overviewEn: Go Go and Honey Lemon quickly clash when they become roommates. Meanwhile, when a thief steals Honey Lemon’s chem-lab purse, it accidentally turns him into a monster.

episodes.name: Fred's Bro-Tillion
episodes.overviewEn: When supervillain Baron Von Steamer crashes Fred’s Bro-Tillion, the Big Hero 6 team springs into action.

episodes.name: Food Fight
episodes.overviewEn: When Aunt Cass stumbles into an underground cooking competition, she thrives and becomes addicted to the excitement.

episodes.name: Muirahara Woods
episodes.overviewEn: Hiro, Fred, and Baymax follow GoGo into the mysterious Muirahara Woods where they get lost and everything electronic strangely fails including Baymax.

episodes.name: Failure Mode
episodes.overviewEn: Hiro becomes demoralized when his latest school project fails spectacularly; the team must take on the incompetent villain, Globby.

episodes.name: Aunt Cass Goes Out
episodes.overviewEn: After Aunt Cass nearly discovers Hiro's secret membership in the Big Hero 6, Hiro tries to set her up with someone to distract her.

episodes.name: The Impatient Patient
episodes.overviewEn: Although he is obviously ill, Hiro refuses to listen to his team-mates and Baymax and only watch from afar as they fight the mercenary team Mad Jacks.

episodes.name: Mr. Sparkles Loses His Sparkle
episodes.overviewEn: Crazy game show host Mr. Sparkles threatens to hurt Hiro's cat Mochi to force Go Go to join a game. But she is very afraid of public appearances.

episodes.name: Killer App
episodes.overviewEn: Wasabi's need for order clashes with Hiro's chaotic work style when they collaborate on a school project.

episodes.name: Small Hiro One
episodes.overviewEn: Hiro becomes frustrated when he's deemed too young to attend a science workshop hosted by SFIT's most famous alumni, Dr. Trevor Trengrove.

episodes.name: Kentucky Kaiju
episodes.overviewEn: Hiro decides to upgrade himself with super strength.

episodes.name: Rivalry Weak
episodes.overviewEn: Honey Lemon takes art classes at a rival school.

episodes.name: Fan Friction
episodes.overviewEn: Karmi posts Big Hero 6 fan fiction, embarrassing Hiro.

episodes.name: Mini-Max
episodes.overviewEn: Hiro invents a tiny robot, Mini-Max, to supervise and be a sidekick to Fred while the rest of the team is in class.

episodes.name: Big Hero 7
episodes.overviewEn: Richardson Mole blackmails his way into Big Hero 6.

episodes.name: Big Problem
episodes.overviewEn: When a monster wreaks havoc in San Fransokyo, Big Hero 6 must go on a real-life monster hunt.

episodes.name: Steamer's Revenge
episodes.overviewEn: Hiro and the others plan the ultimate birthday surprise for Wasabi by recovering his car from the bottom of the bay, but Baron Von Steamer ruins the celebration.

episodes.name: The Bot-Fighter
episodes.overviewEn: To try to prove Yama is behind a mysterious crime spree, perpetrated by tiny bots, Hiro is drawn back into the illegal world of bot-fighting.

episodes.name: Obake Yashiki
episodes.overviewEn: After the gang goes to a spooky haunted house, Hiro keeps seeing Tadashi around the city and ultimately finds himself face to face with his brother.

episodes.name: Countdown to Catastrophe
episodes.overviewEn: Big Hero 6 face their greatest challenge as Obake unleashes his plan on San Fransokyo.

episodes.name: Internabout
episodes.overviewEn: Hiro’s jealousy of Karmi’s internship at Sycorax leads him to intern at Krei Tech.

episodes.name: Seventh Wheel
episodes.overviewEn: Professor Granville becomes increasingly pushy with Big Hero 6 as she helps them figure out a mysterious series of food-related burglaries.

episodes.name: Prey Date
episodes.overviewEn: Hiro and Fred enlist Karmi to find out what happened to Orso Knox, the man who was mysteriously turned into a monster.

episodes.name: Something's Fishy
episodes.overviewEn: When Aunt Cass sets Hiro up on a date, he begins to wonder if he’s missing out on being a regular kid.

episodes.name: Nega-Globby
episodes.overviewEn: Honey Lemon sets out to make Globby human again.

episodes.name: The Fate of the Roommates
episodes.overviewEn: Big Hero 6 must stop a secret underground racing league.

episodes.name: Muira-Horror!
episodes.overviewEn: When Hiro and Go Go accompany Krei to the woods to deal with Nedd Ludd, they run into The Hibagon, a legendary monster.

episodes.name: Something Fluffy
episodes.overviewEn: Mayoi, mysterious yet adorable creatures, begin to appear in San Fransokyo.

episodes.name: Supersonic Sue
episodes.overviewEn: Big Hero 6 attempts to thwart a bank robbery and encounter Supersonic Sue, an old school roller skating villain.

episodes.name: Lie Detector
episodes.overviewEn: Upon discovering Baymax’s ability to detect if a person is lying, Hiro attempts to use him to uncover proof of deceit.

episodes.name: Write Turn Here
episodes.overviewEn: Karmi and Hiro team up to help treat someone with genetically engineered parasites.

episodes.name: City of Monsters (1)
episodes.overviewEn: Karmi and Hiro team up to help treat someone with genetically engineered parasites.

episodes.name: City of Monsters (2)
episodes.overviewEn: Big Hero 6 must continue to fight off a city overrun with monsters.

episodes.name: Mini-Maximum Trouble
episodes.overviewEn: When Fred runs into a string of bad luck, Megan reveals to Hiro that she’s trying to uncover the true identities of Big Hero 6 for her school’s newspaper.

episodes.name: El Fuego
episodes.overviewEn: Professional mech-wrestler El Fuego is intent on becoming the toughest fighter in San Fransokyo and decides he must beat the strongest challenger he can find, Baymax.

episodes.name: The Globby Within
episodes.overviewEn: Nega-Globby takes control of Globby’s body to cause chaos around the city.

episodes.name: Hardlight
episodes.overviewEn: Evil villain Hardlight challenges the Big Hero 6 team to a real-life video game duel.

episodes.name: The Present
episodes.overviewEn: When Hiro finds a wrapped present in the closet, he assumes it's from Aunt Cass and takes it in order to figure out what it is. However, after a mix-up, the present becomes lost and Hiro enlists the Big Hero 6 team to track it down.

episodes.name: Hiro The Villain
episodes.overviewEn: Momakase blackmails Hiro into helping her steal her family's knives from Yama's safe.

episodes.name: Portal Enemy
episodes.overviewEn: Megan confronts Hiro about being a vigilante and threatens to tell Chief Cruz the truth.

episodes.name: Fred the Fugitive
episodes.overviewEn: Fred's invisibility function on his suit glitches during patrol.

episodes.name: Major Blast
episodes.overviewEn: A new villain, Major Blast, appears in the city and targets Fred.

episodes.name: Fear Not
episodes.overviewEn: Supersonic Stu busts his grandmother, Supersonic Sue, out of prison.

episodes.name: Legacies
episodes.overviewEn: Chief Cruz and the police get the upper hand in their battle with both villains and Big Hero 6 when they begin using Buddy Guardians, powerful new robots produced by Krei Tech.

episodes.name: The Hyper-potamus Pizza-Party-torium
episodes.overviewEn: Hiro and a short-handed Big Hero 6 team attempt to stop Noodle Burger Boy and his new family.

episodes.name: Mayor for a Day
episodes.overviewEn: Big Hero 6 responds to Richardson Mole’s every whim when he is made mayor for the day.

episodes.name: The Dog Craze of Summer
episodes.overviewEn: Hiro enlists the help of the team when Granville’s three dogs go missing while under his watch.

episodes.name: Trading Chips
episodes.overviewEn: Hiro switches Baymax’s chip with Mini-Max’s so that Baymax can rescue Mochi.

episodes.name: Mini Noodle Burger Max
episodes.overviewEn: A low-charged Baymax and Mini-Max join forces with Noodle Burger Boy to save Big Hero 6.

episodes.name: A Friendly Face
episodes.overviewEn: When Krei wants to sell the Mayor an automated fleet of shuttle vehicles, Honey Lemon suggests giving the shuttles a friendly face and an upbeat personality.

episodes.name: Big Chibi 6
episodes.overviewEn: Hardlight crashes Karmi’s autograph session.

episodes.name: Cobra and Mongoose
episodes.overviewEn: After Fred is attacked by mechanical cobras, he learns that they were actually sent after Heathcliff.

episodes.name: Better Off Fred
episodes.overviewEn: Fred meets the girl of his dreams, Olivia, only to be rejected by her for reasons he doesn’t understand.

episodes.name: Big Hero Battle
episodes.overviewEn: 4 2 Sing, a famous boy band, decides to be crime fighters and challenge Big Hero 6 to a superhero-off.

episodes.name: Go Go the Wooweroo
episodes.overviewEn: Go Go reluctantly goes undercover as the co-host of Wendy Wower's television show.

episodes.name: The New Nega-Globby
episodes.overviewEn: Globby and Honey Lemon feel guilty about trapping Nega-Globby in the Glop-Vac.

episodes.name: De-Based
episodes.overviewEn: When Basemax opens a spam email, she gets infected with a virus.

episodes.name: The MiSFIT
episodes.overviewEn: In order to recruit child prodigy Rishi Patel, Professor Granville enlists Hiro to give him a tour of SFIT.

episodes.name: Return to Sycorax
episodes.overviewEn: When Krei is lost in the old Sycorax building, the heroes must search the abandoned monster factory to find him.

episodes.name: A Fresh Sparkles
episodes.overviewEn: When Big Hero 6 find Mr. Sparkles working at the Pizza Party-torium, he tells them he's decided to leave the world of crime behind.

episodes.name: Noodle Burger Ploy
episodes.overviewEn: Noodle Burger Boy and the mascots abduct Fred.

episodes.name: Krei-oke Night
episodes.overviewEn: Krei invents a karaoke machine.

episodes.name: The Mascot Upshot
episodes.overviewEn: Hiro plans to defeat The Mascots once and for all.
